name: Gästehaus Rettenbacher
beschreibung: The Gästehaus Rettenbacher in Fulpms in the Stubaital is run as a hotel. The rooms are practically furnished and have a private bathroom. The house is in a quiet location on the edge of town with a view of the Stubaier Alpen. The furnishings are in a traditional Alpine style. Amenities include a lounge with fireplace and a sun terrace. In the morning, a breakfast buffet is served in the breakfast room. The surrounding area offers hiking trails and the Schlick 2000 ski area for winter activities.
